properties.name: main_content

properties.description:
Publisher-marked text preview and citation. Outcome distinguishes marked text, short marked text, fallback to the saved page, a failed reading, a recorded unreadable decision, exclusion, and an unattempted reading. The original body and reader version identify the source. The selector locates marked text. decision_id identifies a recorded unreadable decision. evidence_limited signals that the size limit omitted publisher evidence.
Embedded reference to selected text. Verify selected_text with text_sha256 and find the marked element in saved_body with selector.

properties.name: selected_text
properties.description: Bounded plain text from the cited marked element. Load only on request. Its SHA-256 and length are in main_content. The original remains available for larger or unselected pages.

schema.name: witness_key_map
schema.businessName: Earlier witness keys and the current witness each resolves to
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One witness key this release no longer publishes, with its successor, its candidates, or neither

properties.name: old_key
properties.description:
A witness_key that an earlier body or capture context held for an occasion produces and this release does not publish in witnesses
Disjoint from witnesses.witness_key. A re-fetched body, a newly bound capture context, or a meeting link that moves a print or Senate page off its package or page occasion gives each witness a new key (witness-occurrence-v2 is unchanged); the earlier keys are listed here. A name alone never maps (ct-30fp).

properties.name: witness_key
properties.description:
The current witnesses.witness_key the old key resolves to; null when status is ambiguous or unresolved
The successor can itself be superseded_by a higher-ranked row of the same person; follow witnesses.superseded_by to the row to show.

properties.name: status
properties.description: unambiguous (one successor), ambiguous (several candidates, listed in candidate_keys, none chosen) or unresolved (no candidate)

properties.name: basis
properties.description: The strongest evidence found: occurrence (the same body and locator, published under another occasion or capture context), content (the same occasion, source and print, with an equal name and equal other attributes, at least one of them stated or the same locator; repeats of one person pair in list order) or locator (the same locator, occasion, source and print, an edited name of the same family and given name, every other attribute equal and a position, organization or Bioguide ID stated); null when unresolved

properties.name: candidate_keys
properties.description: With status ambiguous: the current witness keys the old key could resolve to, sorted; empty otherwise

properties.name: occasion
properties.description: The occasion the old key's body is filed under in this release (meeting:{event_id}, package:{package_id}, or page:{sha256_prefix})

properties.name: source
properties.description: Observation source family of the old key (house_xml, congress_gov, senate_page, or mods)

schema.description:
Coverage limits:
Derived from earlier bodies the lake still holds, not from earlier releases: a key published only from a body no longer held has no row
Nullability basis:
witness_key is set exactly when status is unambiguous; basis is null exactly when status is unresolved (ct-kb4w).

properties.name: state
properties.description:
present, partial, claimed, empty, not_stated, unresolved, not_public, confirmed_absent or unknown; these never merge
confirmed_absent only from an undisputed curated negative verdict with event scope; package context alone does not establish absence and zero rows never prove absence. partial means excerpts only; claimed means only a video’s own text; for captions, no observation is unknown, never empty. States rank present > unresolved > empty > unknown > not_stated: unknown, never not_stated, where held evidence is not yet linked. A Senate meeting is unknown for documents and witnesses until Senate committee-page links land (ct-gi01 R2). Captions are not_stated only when the recording is confirmed_absent or not_public.

properties.description: Which relation states it

properties.name: count
properties.description: Rows behind present

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Why a state holds, when known: recording_decision_unresolved_or_conflicting, package_context_only, video_text_only, excerpts_only, stated_documents_not_held, senate_page_links_pending, package_witnesses_unattached, package_names_meeting_unlinked, recording_link_pending or recording_without_video_record; for a present transcript, the sources held (printed_hearing, committee_transcript, captions)
